person_note: The quote set repeatedly exposes participating first-person narration by both Sarah and Handful. Official author materials identify them as the novel's two narrators, an authorized opening excerpt demonstrates Handful's first-person voice, and two independent whole-book descriptions explicitly say their first-person chapters alternate. Because both sustained narrators use the same grammatical person, the correct label is FIRST rather than ALTERNATING. Dialogue, maxims, scripture, and authorial notes were treated as non-base material; isolated third-person references without an exposed narrator were marked unmarked. No credible contrary narrative-person evidence remains.
